summary: One-frame outcome of any mod.io request (client only, registry total 56): the net::UGCResult plus the request's Guid. ls::PublishingSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3BDE2A0; Toolkit GameEngine.dll ls::PublishingSystem::Process*Requests) creates it on a new entity from a request queued by the matching HandleUGC... callback of the mod.io back-end; Written in the PublishingSystem update bg3.exe+0x3BDE2A0 from the per-frame result list (stride 0x38) via the creator bg3.exe+0x3BE21B0. Read by many gui/ecl mod systems (gui::mod::RequestSystem::ProcessDependencyResponses etc.).

fields.name: ResultCode
fields.evidence: net::UGCResult part (0x28 bytes): Windows creator of UGCRequestResult bg3.exe+0x3BE21B0 stores u16 0xE at +0 (byte +0 = 0xE, byte +1 = 0), an empty ls STDString at +8 (size u32 +0x18, capacity +0x1C = 0xF), zero at +0x20; copied member by member in the PublishingSystem update bg3.exe+0x3BDE2A0 (bytes +0,+1, STDString +8, u32 +0x20); macOS net::UGCResult::Visit reads 1,1 byte, a string, 4 bytes. bg3.exe+0x3BDFA70 treats byte 0 == 0 as success (then calls the UGC back-end with the mod id); default 0xE.
